cardServices.title: Our specialties
cardServices.firstCardDescription: Efficient management of production waste to optimize your operational processes and reduce environmental impact.

process.description: Technical precision from reception to final certificate.
process.firstStepDescription: The client requests the service. We coordinate and define the materials, quantities, weight, and collection logistics.
process.secondStepDescription: Our specialized team removes the material directly from the client's premises, guaranteeing maximum safety.
process.thirdStepDescription: We receive and register the material at our facilities. We generate rigorous control and initial evidence of the process.
process.fourthStepDescription: The materials undergo total destruction through controlled industrial processes.
process.fivethStepDescription: We classify and separate the resulting waste to ensure its proper recycling or final disposal.
process.sixthStepDescription: We deliver a complete report with photographic evidence, videos of the process, and the official certificate of destruction.

about.title: Your strategic ally in Fiscal Destructions
about.description: At Environmental Management, we specialize in the certified destruction of obsolete inventory and production losses, serving as your key strategic partner for the execution of your tax-compliant destruction. We distinguish ourselves by transforming a critical and strictly regulated procedure into a completely stress-free experience. Our operations are based on three pillars: total security, confidentiality, and environmental responsibility, ensuring legal support and the highest standards of security and confidentiality required by your company's regulations.
about.misionDescription: We provide sustainable and technological solutions for the collection, destruction, and safe disposal of waste and obsolete materials. We protect our clients' confidential information and mitigate environmental impact, ensuring operational excellence and regulatory compliance.
about.visionDescription: Consolidate ourselves as the national benchmark in the comprehensive management of waste and confidential destruction, being recognized for the excellence of our operation, our active commitment to the circular economy and for providing absolute peace of mind and confidence to each client.
about.descriptionPillar: The guide that gives direction to our strategies and solidity to our decisions.
about.firstPillarDescription: We optimize recycling and minimize waste.
about.secondPillarDescription: Your information and your brand are protected with us.
about.thirdPillarDescription: Full compliance with environmental and health regulations.
about.fourthPillarDescription: Documented and approved processes, step by step.
about.descriptionSectionBenefit: We designed a comprehensive service that combines security, transparency, and efficiency to give you total control over the disposal of your obsolete materials and waste.
about.firstBenefitDescription: We prevent your rejected, expired, or defective merchandise from returning to the informal market, protecting your company's reputation and intellectual property.
about.secondBenefitDescription: We guarantee the complete destruction of materials through certified processes, providing you with the necessary legal and technical support.
about.thirdBenefitDescription: Affordable solutions with premium quality. We maximize the value of your investment without compromising security protocols.
about.fourthBenefitDescription: We know that time is money. We offer personalized service and fast logistics to remove and destroy your sensitive material when you need us to.
about.titleCompromiso: Our commitment to the environment is not a goal, it is our way of operating.
about.descriptionCompromiso: We are committed to promoting sustainable development, ensuring well-being and a positive impact in each of the communities where we operate.
about.descriptionFirstCommitments: We optimize our logistics and technological processes to mitigate and neutralize CO₂ emissions.
about.descriptionSecondCommitments: We promote care and respect for the environment. We don't destroy; we care for our unique and fragile community of life.
about.descriptionThirdCommitments: We cultivate a culture of tolerance and peace, based on care and cooperation, in accordance with the principles of the Earth Charter.

benefit.firstBenefitDescription: We offer the possibility for the client to witness the destruction process, providing certainty and confidence about the final destination of their goods.
benefit.secondBenefitDescription: We document each process through photographs and videos that allow us to clearly and transparently verify the correct execution of the service.
benefit.thirdBenefitDescription: We maintain rigorous control of the material from its collection to its final destruction, guaranteeing traceability and security at all times.
benefit.fourthBenefitDescription: We offer temporary merchandise storage for up to 30 days at no additional cost, allowing the customer to calmly manage the scheduling of destruction with the SAT when necessary.

evidence.descriptionEvidenceSection: Total transparency: records and certifies every destruction process.
evidence.firstEvidenceDescription: Secure destruction of out-of-market merchandise, obsolete goods and promotional materials, protecting your brand and freeing up strategic space in your warehouses.
evidence.secondEvidenceDescription: Confidential handling and certified shredding of documents, files, and inactive records. We guarantee the complete protection of sensitive data under strict security standards.
evidence.thirdEvidenceDescription: Efficient disposal of expired or recalled products. We ensure a clean process that prevents health and commercial risks.
evidence.fourthEvidenceDescription: Disabling and destroying batches with manufacturing errors, incorrect packaging or quality failures, preventing their infiltration into the informal market.
evidence.fivethEvidenceDescription: Regulated processing and destruction of defective electronic components, industrial parts and rigid materials, in full compliance with environmental regulations.

services.title: Destruction and Inventory Management Services
services.description: We guarantee confidentiality, brand protection, and strict regulatory and environmental compliance in every process.
services.descriptionFirstCard: Procedures strictly adhere to tax regulations. We help you legally deduct the value of goods that have lost their commercial value.
services.descriptionSecondCard: Specialized handling of production waste and defective inventory. We neutralize products that do not meet standards to prevent brand dilution and unauthorized resale.
services.descriptionThirdCard: Safe disposal of obsolete, damaged, or defective products. We protect your brand's reputation by preventing merchandise from ending up in informal markets.
services.secondItem: Delivery of minutes and video evidence.
services.descriptionSubCard: Materials processed under our Merma protocol are diverted from traditional waste streams into secondary material cycles.
services.descriptionCardFiscal: We carry out the certified destruction of inventories that have lost their commercial value, strictly adhering to SAT regulations. Our team handles the official documentation and the compilation of the complete file.
services.descriptionCardMerma: We protect your intellectual property and prevent the black market or leakage of defective byproducts. We design containers and provide direct logistics insourcing at your manufacturing plant.
services.descriptionCardInventario: Eliminate storage costs and keep your accounting records clean. We manage batches of expired finished products, obsolete technology, or outdated packaging with complete corporate transparency.
